Bill.BriefDescription: Providing sales and use tax exemptions for certain on-site sewage disposal systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales and use tax exemptions for on-site sewagedisposal systems in aquatic rehabilitation zones; adding a new sectionto chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; andproviding an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of laborand services rendered in respect to construction or installation of aneligible onsite sewage disposal system, tangible personal propertyincorporated as an ingredient or component of an eligible onsitesewage disposal system, or extended warranties for ingredients orcomponents of an eligible onsite sewage disposal system. For thepurposes of this section, "eligible onsite sewage disposal system"means an onsite sewage disposal system constructed or installed in theaquatic rehabilitation zone established in RCW 90.88.010(2) under apermit issued by a local health officer. An exemption under thissection is available only when the buyer provides the seller with an p. 1 HB 3142exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed by thedepartment. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate for theseller's files.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the useof labor and services rendered in respect to construction orinstallation of an eligible onsite sewage disposal system, tangiblepersonal property incorporated as an ingredient or component of aneligible onsite sewage disposal system, or extended warranties foringredients or components of an eligible onsite sewage disposalsystem. For the purposes of this section "eligible onsite sewagedisposal system" has the meaning provided in section 1 of this act.
